target_pdb.description: Path to a target structure (.pdb or .cif). When provided, the adapter generates a minimal BoltzGen design YAML using `target_chain` and `binder_length`. Mutually exclusive with `target_yaml`.

target_yaml.description: Path to a BoltzGen-format design specification YAML. Use this for advanced configurations (multi-target, custom ligand pockets). Mutually exclusive with `target_pdb`.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when neither `target_pdb` nor `target_yaml` is provided.

target_chain.description: Target chain id to bind against. Used only when generating a YAML from `target_pdb`.

binder_length.description: Fixed length of the generated binder chain in residues. Used only when generating a YAML from `target_pdb`. Typical mini-binder range 50-100.

num_designs.description: Number of design backbones to generate per BoltzGen run.

num_diffusion_steps.description: Number of denoising/diffusion steps per sample. Lower means faster but lower-quality samples.

protocol.description: BoltzGen protocol controlling which pipeline steps run and default model choices. Use `protein-anything` for generic mini-binders, `peptide-anything` for short peptides, `protein-small_molecule` for ligand-binding pockets, `antibody-anything`/`nanobody-anything` for antibody-domain designs.

design_only.description: If true, run only the diffusion backbone generation step. If false, run the full pipeline (design + inverse_fold + folding + analyze + filter) which is slower but emits sequenced and ranked designs.

budget.description: Final ranked design set size after filtering. Only meaningful when `design_only` is false.

seed.description: Optional random seed forwarded to BoltzGen via `PYTHONHASHSEED`. Null lets BoltzGen choose its own seed.
